page.overview:
Who is Adventurers?

Adventurers is a LEGO theme that was introduced in January 1998 and ran through July 2003. The main character of the theme is an Australian adventurer by the name of Johnny Thunder (also known as Sam Grant and Joe Freeman). It includes subthemes such as Desert, Jungle, , and Orient Expedition. It is also the basis of multiple LEGOLAND Parks attractions and is featured in a number of video games.

Unlike most other themes, which take place in fictional locations, most of the Adventurers sets take place in areas in real world countries and places, such as Egypt, the Amazon Rainforest, the Himalayas, India, and China. The only fictional sub-theme that did not take place in real life environments took place on , where prehistoric creatures still resided.

The theme essentially consists of four distinct subthemes: Desert, Jungle, , and Orient Expedition. The main characters of the theme are Johnny Thunder, Dr. Kilroy, and Pippin Reed. Villains are also featured to provide contrast for the heroes, including Lord Sam Sinister (AKA Baron von Barron, the main recurring antagonist of the story), Señor Palomar, Mr. Cunningham, and Emperor Chang Wu.

There are two German radio plays released to promote the theme. The first one is called 5542644 Die Jagd nach dem Pharaonenschatz (The Hunt for the Pharaoh's Treasure) and was released in 1998. The second is called 4215473 Die Suche nach dem Goldenen Drachen (The Search for the Golden Dragon) and was released in 2003.
